basis: Approved owner-local development and diagnosis; actual preflight discarded its inner error. One bounded OS metadata observation is needed to distinguish observation failure from occupied server/port. This is not app, browser, loopback HTTP, DB or lifecycle execution.
allowed: matching BoS process identities without raw command lines
capture native child exit and error text
prohibited: owner private files or DB access
result_scope: Any result requires independent review. It cannot serve as successful preflight, satisfy an apply guard, prove runtime availability, or reset prior limits.
on_failure_or_timeout: Retain evidence and stop. No automatic follow-up probe or cleanup of app/server processes. A timed-out diagnostic child is recorded as exit unconfirmed, not completed.
